items.title: The arrest of a Kurdish priest in Syria raises concerns
items.summary: In Syria, the government continues to arrest people for posts on the internet that are considered critical of the state. Now a Kurdish Christian priest has also been arrested after postings deemed offensive to Islam.
items.title_original: Gripandet av kurdisk präst i Syrien väcker oro
items.summary_original: I Syrien fortsätter regeringen att gripa personer för inlägg på internet som anses kritiska mot staten. Nu har även en kurdisk kristen präst gripits efter inlägg som bedömts kränka islam.

items.title: Sweden strengthens Ukraine’s health and medical care through partnership and Swedish expertise
items.summary: Russia’s full-scale invasion has put Ukraine’s health and medical system under severe pressure at the same time as care needs have increased sharply. The Government is therefore allocating SEK 6.9 million to the Swecare Foundation for 2026 to strengthen Ukraine’s health care. This is being done through training initiatives, knowledge exchange and partnerships between Swedish and Ukrainian actors, including in the business sector.
